items.criterion: A second enforcement point beyond the pre-commit hook refuses to push a board shrink (scratch-clone proven: --no-verify shrink commit then push refusal naming counts+lost ids; BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 override still works and stays loud)
items.detail: Mechanism: scripts/install_board_guard.py:57-62 PUSH_BLOCK_TEMPLATE emits `python3 "scripts/board_shrink_check.py" --pre-push || exit 1` into the pre-push hook (installed via --hook pre-push, choices at :102); scripts/board_shrink_check.py:247 run_pre_push grades every stdin ref pair (baseline = board at the remote oid, candidate = board at the local oid) through the shared verdict() contract, which at :193 prints `board-shrink: REFUSED baseline=<n> candidate=<m> lost ids=...` to stderr and exits 1. Scratch-clone proof run BY HAND this session (mktemp -d; git init + bare origin + clone; both hooks installed from the worktree's scripts): after `git commit -qm shrink --no-verify` landed, `git push origin master` exited 1 with the exact line "board-shrink: REFUSED baseline=3 candidate=1 lost ids=B, C" and `git ls-remote` sha 179a86e3e0bb unchanged; then BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 push exited 0 printing "NOTICE BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK override: baseline=3 candidate=1 lost ids=B, C" plus "SHRINK ACCEPTED — the push will drop 2 task row(s) (3 -> 1)", landing d26e70d3c6d0 == local HEAD. Automated mirror run fresh: AUGER_CI=1 /home/kara/auger/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_board_shrink_check.py -x -q -> exit_code 0, "45 passed in 9.28s" (re-run without AUGER_CI: "45 passed in 9.65s"), including test_a_no_verify_shrink_commit_is_refused_at_the_push_path (tests/test_board_shrink_check.py:601, asserts exit 1 + "REFUSED baseline=3 candidate=1 lost ids=B, C" + remote sha unchanged) and test_a_shrink_push_with_the_override_is_loud (:690, asserts exit 0 + NOTICE line + push landed). Full gate (guards.test_command = bash tests/gate.sh) is environment-blocked on this host — "ERROR: DuckBrain URL missing" (exit 2) — matching the repo's own recorded precedent (.gitreins/history/2026-11-21/ecef6bee/summary.md:14); the tested file is scratch-repo-only so this does not mute the evidence. ruff check on all three changed files: "All checks passed!"; gitleaks full-history run this session: "no leaks found" (total 0), so the prior tier1 secrets findings are not from this diff.
